name: fresh-eyes
description: Get fresh eyes on what you just built. A /fresh-eyes:review command distills your session's goal into a task brief (what + why, never how), then delegates to a read-only reviewer subagent that checks your diff against it in its own clean context — no confirmation bias from the build chat. Findings are numbered, category-tagged, and anchored by file:line plus a verbatim quote of the added code; every changed file is accounted for in a coverage line. A second diff-only fact-checker subagent then removes only findings the diff proves wrong (skip with --no-check). Drop a .fresh-eyes/review-rules.md in your repo and both commands enforce it. Then you fix the findings in the session that still knows every decision. Pass --blind for a pure code-only review. A companion /fresh-eyes:review-pr command reviews a GitHub PR by number — yours or a teammate's — in an isolated worktree, optionally answering your specific questions and checking coverage against a Linear issue's requirements (--issue <id>).
